note: Alberta Parks recreation area on Musreau Lake, about 80 km S of Grande Prairie off Hwy 40 (5 km of gravel road). Three loops in mature pine and spruce behind the lakeshore trail; beach, hand boat launch and a day-use area with a boat launch nearby. Loops B and C close September 7; Loop A stays open to the end of the season. In 2026 the taps were non-potable all season (drinking-water advisory from May 14). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jun 5, 2026) and July 2026 brochure: unserviced C$30, FCFS (group area reservable), vault toilets, cistern water (non-potable through 2026 by advisory), no hookups. Season (manual) matches. Lakeview -> not waterfront recommended; site count 69 vs 71 left; pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview - recommend not waterfront): the brochure map puts all three loops north of the shoreline Woodpecker Trail, with the beach and parking between loops A/B and the water. On imagery the southernmost pads are ~65-100 m from the shore through a continuous pine stand (the stand is open-floored but unbroken to a narrow sand strip at the waterline); no sandy beach apron lies in front of the loops. The stored evidence ('front-loop RV sites overlook the lake across the beach') was read on poor striped imagery and is not borne out. The page itself speaks of 'scenic woodland views'. No source shows a lake view from any RV pad: per the unsure-goes-down rule, not waterfront.
